description: Which tools, MCP servers and hooks Claude Code uses, how often they fail, and what hooks cost in time, from OTel log events.

links.title: Tool & Prompt Failures
links.tooltip: Failure reasons and recent failed tool calls and API requests

options.content:
**How to read this dashboard**

- **Source:** `tool_result`, `hook_registered` and `hook_execution_complete` log events. Users whose clients send no logs are left out, and log history starts on 2026-10-27.
- **Weeks** start on Monday (UTC). Weekly charts show only weeks that have ended and fall fully inside the time range.
- **MCP** covers every tool an MCP server provides. Failure rate is failed calls out of all calls.
- **Hooks:** hook counts are kept from the hook attribute backfill onwards; earlier hook events carry no counts and are left out. *Managed* hooks come from `policySettings`, the managed settings an administrator deploys.
- **Filters:** Project, Claude Code OTel teams, User and Repository narrow every panel. Repository is each event's own repository; events outside a repository count as Unknown.

panels.description: Tool calls that finished in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Tool calls",
  SUM(e.tool_name = 'Bash') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Bash share",
  SUM(e.mcp_server_name <> '') AS "MCP calls",
  SUM(e.mcp_server_name <> '' AND e.success = 0) / NULLIF(SUM(e.mcp_server_name <> ''), 0) AS "MCP failure rate",
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(e.mcp_server_name, '')) AS "MCP servers"
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_events e
WHERE e.event_name = 'tool_result'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
  AND e.connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$."vcs.repository.url.full"')), ''), 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.title: Hook Blocks

panels.description: Tool calls in each completed week, split by tool. Edit and Write includes MultiEdit and NotebookEdit; MCP covers every MCP server's tools.

targets.rawSql:
-- Completed Monday-start UTC weeks only; MCP covers every tool an MCP server provides.
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
t AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(e.event_timestamp) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week,
    CASE WHEN e.mcp_server_name <> '' OR LEFT(e.tool_name, 5) = 'mcp__' THEN 'MCP'
      WHEN e.tool_name = 'Bash' THEN 'Bash'
      WHEN e.tool_name = 'Read' THEN 'Read'
      WHEN e.tool_name IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit') THEN 'Edit and Write'
      WHEN e.tool_name IN ('Grep', 'Glob') THEN 'Grep and Glob'
      WHEN e.tool_name IN ('Agent', 'Task') THEN 'Agent'
      WHEN e.tool_name IN ('WebFetch', 'WebSearch') THEN 'Web'
      ELSE 'Other' END AS grp,
    COUNT(*) AS calls
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_events e
  WHERE e.event_name = 'tool_result'
    AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
    AND e.connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$."vcs.repository.url.full"')), ''), 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Bash' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) AS "Bash",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Read' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) AS "Read",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Edit and Write' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) AS "Edit and Write",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Grep and Glob' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) AS "Grep and Glob",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Agent' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) AS "Agent",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'MCP' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) AS "MCP",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Web' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) AS "Web",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Other' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) AS "Other"
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN t ON t.week = w.week
GROUP BY w.week
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tool Mix (Weekly Share of Calls)

panels.description: Each Claude Code OTel team's tool calls over the selected range, with each tool's share of them and the share that failed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.team_slug AS "Team",
  SUM(t.calls) AS "Calls",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Bash' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.calls) AS "Bash",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Read' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.calls) AS "Read",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Edit and Write' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.calls) AS "Edit and Write",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Grep and Glob' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.calls) AS "Grep and Glob",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Agent' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.calls) AS "Agent",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'MCP' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.calls) AS "MCP",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Web' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.calls) AS "Web",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.grp = 'Other' THEN t.calls ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.calls) AS "Other",
  SUM(t.failures) / SUM(t.calls) AS "Failure rate"
FROM (
  SELECT e.team_slug, CASE WHEN e.mcp_server_name <> '' OR LEFT(e.tool_name, 5) = 'mcp__' THEN 'MCP'
      WHEN e.tool_name = 'Bash' THEN 'Bash'
      WHEN e.tool_name = 'Read' THEN 'Read'
      WHEN e.tool_name IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit') THEN 'Edit and Write'
      WHEN e.tool_name IN ('Grep', 'Glob') THEN 'Grep and Glob'
      WHEN e.tool_name IN ('Agent', 'Task') THEN 'Agent'
      WHEN e.tool_name IN ('WebFetch', 'WebSearch') THEN 'Web'
      ELSE 'Other' END AS grp, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(e.success = 0) AS failures
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_events e
  WHERE e.event_name = 'tool_result'
    AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
    AND e.connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$."vcs.repository.url.full"')), ''), 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) t
GROUP BY t.team_slug
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Tool Mix by Team

panels.description: Calls, users, teams, failure rate and time for each MCP server over the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.mcp_server_name AS "Server",
  COUNT(*) AS "Calls",
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key)) AS "Users",
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.team_slug) AS "Teams",
  SUM(e.success = 0) / COUNT(*) AS "Failure rate",
  AVG(e.duration_ms) AS "Average duration",
  SUM(e.duration_ms) AS "Total time"
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_events e
WHERE e.event_name = 'tool_result'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
  AND e.mcp_server_name <> ''
  AND e.connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$."vcs.repository.url.full"')), ''), 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY e.mcp_server_name
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: MCP Servers

panels.description: MCP tool calls in each completed week by server. The 8 servers with the most calls in the range have their own series; the rest are grouped as Other.

targets.rawSql:
-- The 8 servers with the most calls in the range get their own series; the rest are grouped as Other.
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
m AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(e.event_timestamp) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, e.mcp_server_name AS server, COUNT(*) AS calls
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_events e
  WHERE e.event_name = 'tool_result'
    AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
    AND e.mcp_server_name <> ''
    AND e.connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$."vcs.repository.url.full"')), ''), 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
top_servers AS (
  SELECT server FROM (
    SELECT server, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(calls) DESC, server) AS rn
    FROM m JOIN weeks USING (week)
    GROUP BY server
  ) t WHERE rn <= 8
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  COALESCE(t.server, 'Other') AS metric,
  SUM(m.calls) AS value
FROM weeks w
JOIN m ON m.week = w.week
LEFT JOIN top_servers t ON t.server = m.server
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: MCP Calls by Server (Weekly)

panels.description: Users and sessions with hooks registered, per Claude Code OTel team, over the selected range. Managed hooks come from policySettings. Sources and Hook events list what is registered.

targets.rawSql:
-- policySettings is the managed settings source, so its hooks are the ones an administrator deployed.
SELECT e.team_slug AS "Team",
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key)) AS "Users with hooks",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.hook_source')) = 'policySettings' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key) END) AS "Users with managed hooks",
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.session_id) AS "Sessions",
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.hook_source')) ORDER BY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.hook_source')) SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Sources",
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.hook_event')) ORDER BY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.hook_event')) SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Hook events"
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_events e
WHERE e.event_name = 'hook_registered'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
  AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.hook_event')) IS NOT NULL
  AND e.connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$."vcs.repository.url.full"')), ''), 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY e.team_slug
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Hook Coverage by Team

panels.description: Hook runs in each completed week (bars, left axis), with the share that blocked the action (block rate) or failed without blocking (error rate) (lines, right axis).

targets.rawSql:
-- Completed Monday-start UTC weeks only; counts come from hook_execution_complete events.
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
x AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(e.event_timestamp) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week,
    SUM(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.num_hooks')) AS UNSIGNED)) AS hooks,
    SUM(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.num_blocking')) AS UNSIGNED)) AS blocking,
    SUM(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.num_non_blocking_error')) AS UNSIGNED)) AS errors
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_events e
  WHERE e.event_name = 'hook_execution_complete'
    AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
    AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.num_hooks')) IS NOT NULL
    AND e.connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$."vcs.repository.url.full"')), ''), 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  COALESCE(x.hooks, 0) AS "Hook runs",
  x.blocking / NULLIF(x.hooks, 0) AS "Block rate",
  x.errors / NULLIF(x.hooks, 0) AS "Error rate"
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN x ON x.week = w.week
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Hook Outcomes (Weekly)

panels.description: Time hooks took per prompt, summed over the prompt's hook runs, as the median and the average in each completed week.

targets.rawSql:
-- Hook time per prompt sums total_duration_ms over the prompt's hook_execution_complete events.
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
per_prompt AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(MIN(e.event_timestamp)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(MIN(e.event_timestamp)) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, SUM(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.total_duration_ms')) AS UNSIGNED)) AS ms
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_events e
  WHERE e.event_name = 'hook_execution_complete'
    AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
    AND e.prompt_id <> ''
    AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.total_duration_ms')) IS NOT NULL
    AND e.connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$."vcs.repository.url.full"')), ''), 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY e.prompt_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT week, ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY week ORDER BY ms) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY week) AS n
  FROM per_prompt
),
x AS (
  SELECT week, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(n / 2) THEN ms END) AS p50, AVG(ms) AS avg_ms
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY week
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  x.p50 AS "Median per prompt",
  x.avg_ms AS "Average per prompt"
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN x ON x.week = w.week
ORDER BY 1

-- The label is the person's full name from their DevLake account, falling back to the email; the value stays the
-- email (or user key) that every panel filters on.
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS __text, u.user AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
) u
ORDER BY 1;

-- Repositories the selected users' prompts ran in, labelled as on Token Usage by Repository.
-- 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real repository_url is always an
-- https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;
